name: @stynx-nyx/eslint-config
description: Shared flat ESLint profiles for STYNX packages and STYNX-based applications

scripts.test:coverage: node ../../scripts/node-test-coverage.mjs test/eslint-config.spec.mjs test/rule-families.spec.mjs test/typed-query-lint.spec.mjs test/query-declaration-census.spec.mjs test/legacy-testing-assertions.spec.mjs test/root-database-tooling.spec.mjs
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const path of ['dist', 'coverage']) require('node:fs').rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/eslint-config.spec.mjs test/rule-families.spec.mjs test/typed-query-lint.spec.mjs test/query-declaration-census.spec.mjs test/legacy-testing-assertions.spec.mjs test/root-database-tooling.spec.mjs
